body:
## What it is

Airalo sells prepaid eSIM data plans for Suriname. You buy a plan on Airalo's website or app and install it as an eSIM on your phone, alongside your usual SIM. Airalo's feed listed 13 local plans for Suriname on 13 November 2026.

## Plans and prices

|---|---|---|---|

| 3 GB | 3 days | US$15.50 | US$5.17 |
| Unlimited | 3 days | US$25.50 | — |
| Unlimited | 5 days | US$36.50 | — |

| 10 GB | 7 days | US$36.00 | US$3.60 |

| 5 GB | 15 days | US$22.50 | US$4.50 |
| 10 GB | 15 days | US$37.00 | US$3.70 |
| 5 GB | 30 days | US$23.00 | US$4.60 |
| 10 GB | 30 days | US$38.00 | US$3.80 |

Prices are in USD, as Airalo's feed gives them. Price per GB is the plan price divided by its data allowance.

## How the plans work

The validity period starts as soon as the eSIM is installed on a device, even outside of its coverage area. If you install your eSIM outside of its coverage area, the validity period will begin before it can connect to a network. Every plan can be topped up. Airalo lists no ID verification (eKYC) for these plans. Plan type: Data.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from Airalo's product feed, the plan list Airalo publishes for its affiliates. Airalo's checkout shows the final price and whether your phone supports eSIM.
